events.symptom: Windows shell open ignored when LTspice instance is already running; document was not loaded into workspace.
events.resolution: Use in-app hotkey Ctrl+O to open native file dialog, type full path, and press Enter.
events.refinement: Seed 'open_schematic' recipe in LTspice AST using Ctrl+O hotkey instead of OS shell open.

events.symptom: Process hangs indefinitely when executed with -b flag without active graphical session context.
events.resolution: Launch LTspice in GUI mode and trigger simulation via Run toolbar button (#7 @ 467, 279).
events.refinement: Mark batch CLI mode as unreliable for ad-hoc agent automation; prefer GUI simulation with UIA run trigger.

events.symptom: pywintypes.com_error: Call was rejected by callee (-2147418111).
events.resolution: Ensure document is not in modal editing state, or create document via file generator / doc.SaveAs before interactive dispatch.
events.refinement: Add modal state check and retry guard for COM automation calls on Office 2010/2013.
